2609.18676.title: The Uneven Impact of Generative AI on Student Learning: Examining the Roles of Reliance, Evaluation Literacy, and Course Policy in AI-related Courses
2609.18676.paper_summary: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is changing how students learn, yet the roles of course context, cognitive reliance, evaluation literacy, and early reliance remain underexplored. Using survey responses from 118 students across 12 AI-related courses at our institution, we examined differences in GenAI use and perceived learning experiences. We identified four user clusters: high-use students reporting many benefits, light users reporting less reliance and fewer benefits, and two moderate-use groups reporting different levels of benefit. We also found significant differences between free- and premium-version users, single- and multiple-tool users, and students experiencing different instructor policies. In multivariable regression models, academic benefit was associated with early reliance and academic task support; positive impact was associated with cognitive reliance, academic task support, confidence in GenAI reliability, and instructor policy; and negative impact was associated with early reliance and attitudinal change. The association between early reliance and negative impact became stronger as evaluation literacy increased. Finally, perceptions of GenAI-enhanced learning appear to reflect cognitive, performance, and self-efficacy benefits, while concerns about stress and diminished critical thinking are associated with lower perceived learning benefits. These findings suggest that institutions need better policies to address such inequities so that institutions can enable students to benefit from increasingly capable AI systems.
2609.18676.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧（GenAI）正在改變學生的學習方式，但課程背景、認知依賴、評估素養和早期依賴的角色仍然未被充分探討。<lb/>我們使用來自本機構12門與AI相關課程的118名學生的調查回應，檢視了GenAI使用和感知學習經驗的差異。<lb/>我們識別出四個使用者群體：高使用者報告許多好處，輕度使用者報告較少的依賴和較少的好處，以及兩個中度使用群體報告不同程度的好處。<lb/>我們還發現免費版和付費版用戶、單一工具和多重工具用戶，以及經歷不同教師政策的學生之間存在顯著差異。<lb/>在多變量回歸模型中，學術好處與早期依賴和學術任務支持相關；正面影響與認知依賴、學術任務支持、對GenAI可靠性的信心和教師政策相關；而負面影響則與早期依賴和態度變化相關。<lb/>早期依賴與負面影響之間的關聯隨著評估素養的提高而增強。<lb/>最後，對GenAI增強學習的看法似乎反映了認知、表現和自我效能的好處，而對壓力和批判性思維減少的擔憂則與較低的感知學習好處相關。<lb/>這些發現表明，機構需要更好的政策來解決這些不平等，以便讓學生能夠從越來越強大的AI系統中受益。
